rationale: Arbour Heights is a 174-bed underlying facility, not a standalone manager-level portfolio company. Ontario's current licensee record places it under Axium Extendicare LTC II LP, the successor to AXR Operating (National) LP and the Ontario-Manitoba portion of the Revera-Axium platform. Current Extendicare filings disclose 26 operating homes and 3,502 beds, with Axium at 85% and Extendicare at a 15% managed interest. Revera's western interest moved to a separate AgeCare-Axium platform in 2022 and Revera sold its remaining 15% Ontario-Manitoba interest to Extendicare on August 1, 2023. No later sale, restructuring, insolvency or signed pending ownership transfer was found through August 18, 2026. The proposal keeps the existing platform record as canonical, redirects the Arbour facility record, removes the unsupported AxInfra Fund I-IV heuristic, preserves historical ownership and makes no Deal Database change.

beforeImage.name: Revera Joint Venture
beforeImage.description: Revera Joint Venture is a long-term care ownership platform covering facilities in Ontario, Alberta, Manitoba, and British Columbia. The venture owns seniors care and long-term care real estate operated by Revera, serving residents who require continuing and higher-acuity care services. Its operating model is asset-heavy, with revenues supported by facility ownership and long-duration demand in regulated care markets rather than commodity or merchant exposure. At formation, the joint venture covered 32 long-term care homes, and later acquisitions expanded the platform with additional Ontario homes including Arbour Heights. Axium-managed funds acquired a 75% interest in the venture in 2018 while Revera retained 25%.

afterImage.name: Axium Extendicare LTC II LP
afterImage.description: Axium Extendicare LTC II LP is the Ontario-Manitoba long-term-care ownership platform that succeeded AXR Operating (National) LP and the relevant portion of the former Revera-Axium joint venture. At June 30, 2026, it owned 26 operating homes with 3,502 beds; Axium held 85% through Axium LTC Limited Partnership, while Extendicare held a 15% managed interest and operated the homes. The platform serves residents requiring provincially regulated long-term care and receives operating, management and procurement services from Extendicare. Arbour Heights is a 174-bed Kingston home beneath this platform, not a separate PortCo. The original venture formed in 2017 at 75% Axium and 25% Revera, separated its western assets into an AgeCare-Axium venture in 2022, and became Axium Extendicare LTC II LP when Extendicare acquired Revera's remaining 15% Ontario-Manitoba interest in 2023. No later platform sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 18, 2026.
